modules.name: Amenities (Halls and Shared Facilities)
modules.description: Covers setting up bookable amenities and shared facilities per project, booking them, tracking live occupancy, and closing them for maintenance.

requirements.title: Add any amenity per project
requirements.description: On the web, an amenity can be added per project with name, type (Bookable or Shared), capacity, open hours, slot length and rules. Once saved, it shows in that project's app.

requirements.title: Book a bookable amenity
requirements.description: Residents can book a slot of a bookable amenity on mobile. A booked slot shows as unavailable when selected.

requirements.title: Approve booking
requirements.description: Bookings can be approved on mobile. When two requests exist for one slot and one is approved, the other is auto-rejected.

requirements.title: Cancel booking
requirements.description: A booking can be cancelled on mobile before the cut-off time, and the slot becomes free again. Priority is Should.

requirements.title: Book a shared facility slot
requirements.description: On mobile, a resident can book a date and slot that has space. The slot count goes up by the number of members booked.

requirements.title: Check in and check out
requirements.description: Residents can check in and check out on mobile. A resident tapping Check In with 2 members raises the live count by 3.

requirements.title: Live count for everyone
requirements.description: Any resident of the project sees, for each shared facility, the number of people inside against capacity.

requirements.title: Automatic check-out
requirements.description: On web and mobile, a user who has not checked out by slot end or closing time is checked out automatically.

requirements.title: No-show release
requirements.description: On web and mobile, if there is no check-in within the set minutes, the slot is freed. Priority is Should.

requirements.title: Close for maintenance
requirements.description: On mobile, a facility can be marked closed. Booking then stops and booked users are notified.

rules.title: Capacity limit blocks check-in
rules.description: When a shared facility has reached capacity, a check-in attempt is blocked and a message is shown.
